original_prompt: Create a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a GKE Standard cluster with one node pool for production workloads.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Create a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a GKE Standard cluster with one node pool for production workloads.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
imports:
  - path: gke-cluster.jinja

resources:
  - name: prod-gke-cluster
    type: gke-cluster.jinja
    properties:
      clusterName: prod-cluster
      region: us-central1
      network: default
      subnetwork: default
      releaseChannel: REGULAR
      masterIpv4CidrBlock: 172.16.0.0/28
      podsSecondaryRangeName: gke-pods
      servicesSecondaryRangeName: gke-services
      masterAuthorizedNetworks:
        - displayName: corp-network
          cidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/8
      nodePoolName: prod-pool
      nodeCount: 3
      minNodes: 3
      maxNodes: 10
      machineType: e2-standard-4
      diskSizeGb: 100
      diskType: pd-ssd
      serviceAccount: gke-node-sa@PROJECT_ID.iam.gserviceaccount.com

outputs:
  - name: clusterEndpoint
    value: $(ref.prod-gke-cluster.endpoint)
  - name: clusterName
    value: $(ref.prod-gke-cluster.name)

---
# gke-cluster.jinja
{% set CLUSTER_NAME = properties['clusterName'] %}
{% set REGION = properties['region'] %}
{% set PROJECT = env['project'] %}

resources:
  - name: {{ CLUSTER_NAME }}
    type: gcp-types/container-v1:projects.locations.clusters
    properties:
      parent: projects/{{ PROJECT }}/locations/{{ REGION }}
      cluster:
        name: {{ CLUSTER_NAME }}
        description: Production GKE Standard cluster
        location: {{ REGION }}
        network: projects/{{ PROJECT }}/global/networks/{{ properties['network'] }}
        subnetwork: projects/{{ PROJECT }}/regions/{{ REGION }}/subnetworks/{{ properties['subnetwork'] }}
        initialClusterVersion: "1.28"
        releaseChannel:
          channel: {{ properties['releaseChannel'] }}
        loggingService: logging.googleapis.com/kubernetes
        monitoringService: monitoring.googleapis.com/kubernetes
        monitoringConfig:
          componentConfig:
            enableComponents:
              - SYSTEM_COMPONENTS
              - WORKLOADS
          managedPrometheusConfig:
            enabled: true
        loggingConfig:
          componentConfig:
            enableComponents:
              - SYSTEM_COMPONENTS
              - WORKLOADS
        ipAllocationPolicy:
          useIpAliases: true
          clusterSecondaryRangeName: {{ properties['podsSecondaryRangeName'] }}
          servicesSecondaryRangeName: {{ properties['servicesSecondaryRangeName'] }}
        privateClusterConfig:
          enablePrivateNodes: true
          enablePrivateEndpoint: false
          masterIpv4CidrBlock: {{ properties['masterIpv4CidrBlock'] }}
        masterAuthorizedNetworksConfig:
          enabled: true
          cidrBlocks:
          {% for net in properties['masterAuthorizedNetworks'] %}
            - displayName: {{ net['displayName'] }}
              cidrBlock: {{ net['cidrBlock'] }}
          {% endfor %}
        networkPolicy:
          enabled: true
          provider: CALICO
        addonsConfig:
          httpLoadBalancing:
            disabled: false
          horizontalPodAutoscaling:
            disabled: false
          networkPolicyConfig:
            disabled: false
          gcePersistentDiskCsiDriverConfig:
            enabled: true
          gcpFilestoreCsiDriverConfig:
            enabled: true
        workloadIdentityConfig:
          workloadPool: {{ PROJECT }}.svc.id.goog
        databaseEncryption:
          state: ENCRYPTED
          keyName: projects/{{ PROJECT }}/locations/{{ REGION }}/keyRings/gke-ring/cryptoKeys/gke-key
        binaryAuthorization:
          evaluationMode: PROJECT_SINGLETON_POLICY_ENFORCE
        shieldedNodes:
          enabled: true
        verticalPodAutoscaling:
          enabled: true
        maintenancePolicy:
          window:
            recurringWindow:
              window:
                startTime: "2024-01-01T03:00:00Z"
                endTime: "2024-01-01T07:00:00Z"
              recurrence: "FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=SA,SU"
        nodePools:
          - name: {{ properties['nodePoolName'] }}
            initialNodeCount: {{ properties['nodeCount'] }}
            autoscaling:
              enabled: true
              minNodeCount: {{ properties['minNodes'] }}
              maxNodeCount: {{ properties['maxNodes'] }}
            management:
              autoUpgrade: true
              autoRepair: true
            upgradeSettings:
              maxSurge: 1
              maxUnavailable: 0
              strategy: SURGE
            config:
              machineType: {{ properties['machineType'] }}
              diskSizeGb: {{ properties['diskSizeGb'] }}
              diskType: {{ properties['diskType'] }}
              imageType: COS_CONTAINERD
              serviceAccount: {{ properties['serviceAccount'] }}
              oauthScopes:
                - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform
              metadata:
                disable-legacy-endpoints: "true"
              labels:
                env: production
                workload: general
              tags:
                - gke-node
                - prod
              shieldedInstanceConfig:
